name: ShowOps Agent
author: ShowOps
description: Connects this FPP player to your ShowOps account at api.showops.io for monitoring and remote management. On instruction from ShowOps the agent can set FPP's restart banner, upgrade FPP or the OS, change volume, skip playlist items, change playlists and schedules, run FPP's display test for up to 5 minutes, and open a remote support session through a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's FPP web UI (cloudflared is fetched from github.com and pinned). Diagnostics, map location, configuration backup and restore (passwords removed), and the reboot banner stay off until you turn them on in the plugin page. The agent is closed source and does not replace its own binary. Pair only on a trusted network. Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone, and 64-bit x86 Debian or Ubuntu (including FPP in Docker).

privacy.summary: Alerts you when a show does not start or FPP or power has trouble. Song and volume go only while its live page is open. Changes happen only when you ask. Diagnostics, location and backups start off.

sends.what: hostname, FPP, OS and agent version, board, playback, next show time, CPU, memory and disk use
sends.why: to show this player's status in your ShowOps account

sends.what: alerts as they happen: a show that did not start, fppd stopping, under-voltage, FPP's warnings
sends.why: to alert you, even when nobody has ShowOps open

sends.what: hostname and a hash of this player's machine id and MAC addresses (a hardware identifier)
sends.why: to recognize this player when you pair it

sends.what: song, playlist, position and volume while someone has this player's live page open in ShowOps
sends.why: to show the live page in your ShowOps account

sends.what: model names and their channel ranges from FPP's model list
sends.why: to let you pick models in ShowOps Test lights, read only when you open it
to place the show on a map when you enable location

sends.what: installed plugins, network details, FPP system status and logs
sends.why: to troubleshoot this player when you enable diagnostics

sends.what: a configuration backup with passwords removed
sends.why: to restore this player when you enable backups

sends.what: FPP's web pages, and the page of a controller FPP lists, during a console you open
sends.why: so you, or a helper you let in, can use FPP and its controllers from ShowOps

sends.what: this player's FPP web pages during a remote support session
sends.why: so the helper signed in to ShowOps can open FPP remotely

collects.what: pairing token and the hardware identifier hash for this player

systemChanges.what: Installs the fpp-monitor-agent systemd service, run as fpp. Without systemd (Docker), postStart.sh runs it as fpp under a supervisor script
Install and Update fetch the closed-source agent from api.showops.io, SHA-256 checked against the checksums committed in this plugin
For remote support the agent fetches pinned cloudflared 2024.8.3 from github.com
Remote support can open a Cloudflare Tunnel to this player's web UI
On request sets FPP's restart and reboot banners, upgrades FPP or the OS, changes volume, skips playlist items, and edits playlists and schedules
If an FPP upgrade stops partway, runs FPP's own Rebuild to recover
On request runs FPP's own display test pattern, refused while a show plays and stopped after at most 5 minutes
Restores a ShowOps configuration backup onto this player, only when backups are turned on
Backup reads FPP settings and blanks password, token, key, secret and pass fields before upload
Probes LAN hosts and ports only if listed in network_allowlist, which is empty by default
Restarts the ShowOps service with FPP's sudo helper

privacy.other: Pair only on a trusted network. Pairing credentials stay in plugindata until Unpair or uninstall (a Reinstall on FPP 10.4+ keeps them). The agent does not replace its own binary; Update in Plugin Manager installs new agents. ShowOps can ask FPP to upgrade this plugin through FPP's own plugin upgrade. Remote support is signed in through ShowOps, opened from the cloud, and idle-limited. cloudflared stays on the pinned 2024.8.3 build. A remote session reaches this player's FPP web UI and, only when you pick one, the web page of a controller FPP itself lists as an output or MultiSync system at a private address; nothing else on your network. ShowOps can turn a listed capability off and cannot turn a switch on. Song, playlist, position and volume go to ShowOps only while someone has this player's live page open; alerts go out whenever they happen. In Docker the agent's supervisor keeps running when fppd stops, so it can report that, and uninstall stops it.
